# Pribanic & Pribanic

> > Pittsburgh's premier personal injury law firm with 40+ years of experience securing multi-million dollar verdicts for clients across Western Pennsylvania.

Pribanic & Pribanic is a dedicated personal injury law firm based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, led by Victor H. Pribanic and Jeffrey A. Pribanic. The firm specializes in medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, and catastrophic injuries, serving clients throughout Allegheny County and Western Pennsylvania.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Personal Injury Law
- Motor Vehicle Accidents
- Workers' Compensation
- Wrongful Death
- Product Liability
- Birth Injury
- Catastrophic Injuries
- Nursing Home Neglect
- Pittsburgh Attorney
- Trial Lawyers

- Medical Negligence
- Statute of Limitations
- Legal Representation

## Practice Areas

- [Medical Malpractice Attorney](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice): Pittsburgh medical malpractice lawyer fighting negligent doctors and hospitals
- [Motor Vehicle Accidents](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/motor-vehicle-accident): Pittsburgh car accident lawyer protecting rights against insurance companies
- [Truck Accident Lawyer](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/motor-vehicle-accident/truck-accident-lawyer): Pittsburgh truck accident lawyer fighting big trucking companies for maximum compensation
- [Wrongful Death Attorney](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/wrongful-death-attorney): Pittsburgh wrongful death lawyer seeking compensation and justice for families
- [Birth Injury Lawyer](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/birth-injury-lawyer): Pittsburgh birth injury lawyer fighting for justice in preventable birth injury cases
- [Catastrophic Injuries Lawyer](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/catastrophic-injury-lawyer): Pittsburgh catastrophic injury lawyer handling life-changing accident cases
- [Workers' Compensation Lawyer](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/workers-compensation): Pittsburgh workers' compensation lawyer securing benefits and medical coverage
- [Product Liability Attorney](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/defective-product-attorney): Pittsburgh product liability lawyer holding manufacturers accountable for defects
- [Nursing Home Neglect Lawyers](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas/nursing-home-neglect): Pittsburgh nursing home neglect lawyers protecting elderly from corporate care failures
- [Practice Areas Overview](https://pribanic.com/practice-areas): Pribanic & Pribanic practice areas overview: personal injury, medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents
